title: Bariatric surgery coverage, NCD 100.1 as operationalized by Palmetto GBA (Jurisdictions J and M)
compiled_by: T-87, hand-compiled from the T-02 corpus as extended by D101

jurisdiction.note: Every quantified constant below comes from L34576, not from CMS. NCD 100.1 quantifies nothing. This tree differs from Noridian's in shape, not only in value: no run-length criterion, weight rather than BMI documented monthly, and a multidisciplinary evaluation the pipeline has no extractor for. Two criteria are therefore declared unclaimed and abstained on, never omitted (D101).

criteria.label: BMI at or above the coverage threshold

source.quote: Patient has a BMI ≥ 35.0 kg/m² (Class II or Class III obesity)

bmi_threshold.note: Inclusive, as Noridian's. E12's 35.0 boundary is MET here too.

lookback_months.note: Decided, not sourced (D40, owner, 2026-09-08): 12 months by analogy to A53028's program-participation window — the measurement must be contemporaneous with the 12 months of evidence the determination examines. Neither source document defines a BMI recency window; a span here would fabricate a citation for a judgment. Closes open question 4.

source.quote: Patient has at least 1 co-morbidity related to obesity

value_set_id.note: Referenced, not inlined, as in Noridian's tree (D3, D23). L34576 names no code list of its own; the SNOMED set T-05 built from A53028's Group 1 is reused as the operational reading of 'co-morbidity related to obesity', and that reuse is a compilation choice recorded here (D101).

criteria.label: A physician-supervised weight management program is documented

source.quote: in a weight-management program that is supervised by a physician or other health care professionals

min_events.note: Existence check, as Noridian's c1 (REQ-36, D13). Zero events is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never NOT_MET.

criteria.label: The qualifying run is recent enough

source.quote: within the last 12 months prior to bariatric surgery

recency_window_months.note: REQ-32 forbids hardcoding it. Not scoped to a c3: L34576 states no run length, so the run this scopes to is established by having events at all (D101).

documented_measure.note: Weight, where A53028 says 'weight and BMI'. This is what makes the criterion unclaimed.

criteria.note: Unclaimed (D101): the extractor reads a documented BMI and has no weight field (D15, T-15's schema). A BMI proxy would be sound and incomplete — a documented BMI implies a documented weight, but a month documenting weight without a BMI would read NOT_MET. Claimed when the extraction schema gains a weight field, which is a new measurement (D45).

source.quote: Physician-supervised programs consisting exclusively of pharmacological management are not sufficient to meet this requirement.

pharmacological_management_alone_insuffi.note: Recorded because it is policy; no predicate consumes it at v1, as in Noridian's tree.

criteria.label: A multidisciplinary evaluation within the previous six months

source.quote: A thorough multidisciplinary evaluation within the previous 6 months which includes ALL of the following:

evaluation_window_months.note: Four named components follow in the source: bariatric surgeon, primary care referral, mental health, nutrition.

criteria.note: Unclaimed (D101): the pipeline extracts weight-management encounters and program assertions, and has no extractor for a multidisciplinary evaluation. Abstains with NOT_EVALUATED_BY_THIS_SYSTEM so the determination names what a reviewer still owes. Decomposed (D107), it is extraction of four documented components, then set membership and a six-month window -- REQ-38's shape, not REQ-44's; claimed when the tree declares the fact type (v1.6), which is a new measurement (D45).

discrepancy_tolerance.note: Decided, not sourced (D51, owner, 2026-09-08): 1.0 BMI points. No source text bounds it — it is a judgment about what wastes a reviewer's attention, not a coverage rule. A full point is beyond rounding and beyond the variance of two measurements taken weeks apart (roughly six pounds), so a disagreement at or above it is a documentation problem rather than noise. D14's two poles are both handled. The eval set does not decide this: E10 is a gap of 5.77 and E10c a gap of 0.05, so 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 all pass — the choice is materiality, not a constraint the suite validates.

reconciled_facts.note: REQ-34: the structured value is authoritative and the disagreement is advisory, unless the two fall on opposite sides of bmi_threshold, in which case the criterion resolves INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with gap_reason SOURCE_CONFLICT (D11).

categorical_exclusions.label: Bariatric surgery for T2DM with BMI below 35 is nationally non-covered

claim.quote: CMS determines that open and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGBP), laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding (LAGB), and open and laparoscopic biliopancreatic diversion with duodenal switch (BPD/DS) in Medicare beneficiaries who have type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and a BMI less than 35 are not reasonable and necessary under section 1862(a)(1)(A) of the Social Security Act, and therefore are not covered.

source.quote: a BMI less than 35 are not reasonable and necessary

bmi_upper_bound.note: Exclusive: the exclusion fires below 35, coverage begins at 35 (E12). The one numeric constant legitimately sourced to the NCD - this exclusion is national and quantified by CMS itself, unlike the criteria constants D21 traces to Noridian (D41).

condition_binding.basis: The NCD names type 2 diabetes mellitus in prose; no corpus document binds the diagnosis to a code (D28's posture, D41).

categorical_exclusions.note: Lives in the NCD's transmittal history (04/2009, TN 100, CR6419), not the Indications body - the body never states it. Scope: the sentence names RYGBP, LAGB and BPD/DS, the nationally covered set exactly; it predates the 2012 LSG delegation and never names LSG, so contractor-determined requests skip it (D41).

procedure_sets.note: Three pairwise-disjoint answers to what a policy says about a requested code, so that nationally denied, delegated to the contractor, and outside this policy never merge (D26). Members are procedures in D28's two-citation shape; identity code bindings are the lookup keys, facility_code_lists are not (D30). REQ-2 reads the non-covered set; a code bound in no set is REQ-1's NO_POLICY_FOUND. National sets transcribed from the same NCD and r931cp spans as Noridian's tree (D100).

nationally_covered.procedure: Open and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGBP)

coverage_claim.quote: Effective for services performed on and after February 21, 2006, Open and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGBP), open and laparoscopic Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch (BPD/DS) or Gastric Reduction Duodenal Switch (BPD/GRDS), and laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding (LAGB) are covered for Medicare beneficiaries who have a body-mass index ≥ 35, have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity, and have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity.
coverage_claim.note: One sentence covers all three nationally covered procedures; each entry cites it. The conditions it states (BMI >= 35, one co-morbidity, prior unsuccessful medical treatment) are the criteria tree's national floor.
